mission: Implement the missing Prospero platform branches PolyHook needs for its x64Detour path (protection translation, old-protection lookup via the proven KERN_PROC_VMMAP walker, near-address executable allocator, DebugBreak), host-test them with mock VMMAP fixtures, and compile-gate them against the composition's polyhook unit argv. Deliver an additive integration diff; composition absorption is a launch-11 matrix row.

in_scope: Host-side implementation of the PLH Prospero branches (proposal code, compiled and host-tested; never executed on target)
Protection translation PROT_* <-> PLH::ProtFlag (SDK numbering PROT_NONE 0 / READ 1 / WRITE 2 / EXEC 4, pinned SDK sys/mman.h:52-55)
Old-protection lookup before every mprotect, using a byte-close port of the proven v3 mode-1 KERN_PROC_VMMAP walk (ig_vmmap_walk lineage) with the proven trust gate
Map-gated fail-closed MemAccessor read/write/copy (refuses, never dereferences, uncovered or untrusted memory; igf4 covered_not_readable discipline)
Executable allocator (bounded hint-mmap policy RWX-then-RW-with-exec-transition-flag) for PLH boundAlloc/boundAllocLegacy
Raw-syscall backend shims (SYS_mprotect 74, SYS_munmap 73, SYS_mmap 477 parsed from pinned SDK sys/syscall.h:81-82,398) compiled but never executed
Compile gate with the exact composition polyhook unit argv (prospero-clang++, patched/include first, ASMJIT_STATIC etc.)
out_of_scope: Any console contact, target execution, linking, or in-game probe (IGW-1 remains controller+user gated)
Resolution of the exec-writability verdict (W_WORKS / W_FAILS_R_WORKS / BOTH_FAIL) - this layer documents its dependencies on that verdict, it does not settle it
Composition absorption (launch-11 matrix row), UE4SS-side wiring, hook activation

claims.text: The missing verified contract (port report lines 20-22) is implementable additively: all absent PLH symbols (TranslateProtection x2, MemAccessor::mem_copy/safe_mem_write/safe_mem_read/mem_protect, boundedAllocSupported/boundAlloc/boundAllocLegacy/boundAllocFree/getAllocationAlignment/getPageSize, PolyHook2DebugBreak) can be defined in ONE new TU with zero edits to canonical or port-overlay PLH sources, because on __PROSPERO__ the existing sources' platform chains select no branch and define none of these symbols (no ODR conflict).

Protection translation is exact under the SDK numbering and needs no kernel verdict: the SDK PROT_* values (0/1/2/4) are the FreeBSD values the Linux branch already translates; host tests cover round-trips for every flag combination PLH passes (X, R, W, R|W, RWX, NONE).

Old-protection lookup is implementable from the proven walker: a byte-close C++ port of ig_vmmap_walk (mode 1, variable kve_structsize stride, offsets 0/8/16/56, per-record sanity, 16-KiB alignment census) plus ig_vmmap_trustworthy gate gives current-invocation old-prot from the raw kve_protection bits; host fixtures reuse the proven synthetic-record pattern including the exact live spans [0x400000,0x787c000) prot=4 and [0x970c000,0x9a34000) prot=3.

mem_protect must return UNSET + status=false when no single trusted span covers the aligned request; PLH's MemoryProtector destructor then skips the restore and isGood() is false, so an uncovered hook fails gracefully instead of crashing. This is host-tested against the real PLH MemProtector.hpp RAII code compiled on the host.

The allocator's RWX-vs-RW choice is a documented policy, not a verified permission: mmap RWX (one syscall, SYS_mmap 477) is attempted first; on refusal the backend retries PROT_READ|PROT_WRITE and records exec_transition_required, and publishing exec permission later goes through the same raw SYS_mprotect 74 path whose success IS the open kernel verdict. If both transitions fail (BOTH_FAIL branch), PLH cannot obtain executable+writable memory and detour arming must stay disabled. Nothing in this worker settles which branch reality takes.

All four platform TUs (PolyHookProsperoPlatform.cpp, MemAccessor.cpp, MemProtector.cpp, Misc.cpp) plus a branch-selection control compile exit 0 under the composition's exact polyhook unit argv; nm on the new object shows the previously missing PLH symbols now defined; nothing is linked and nothing is executed.

not_claimed: No in-game behavior of any syscall (74/73/477) - the numbers are FreeBSD-generic parsed from the pinned SDK; SYS_mmap 477 and SYS_munmap 73 are themselves unverified on this kernel; only getpid 20 and sysctl 202 are console-proven
No claim that mmap/mprotect succeed or fail gracefully on Prospero (igf5's raw syscall-74 attempt is crash-correlated with the harshest outcome of the day and never returned a record)
No claim that AsmJit's JitRuntime works on PS5 (out of scope, port report line 22)
No hook activation, no quality score, no completion claim
